choice_prompt:16:1520909008.source_cn: 对于雅库伯尔的战士来说……这是一种耻辱，说明他们是弱者。弱者只能得到最简单的治疗……

say:18:1520909009:0.text: The Hunting God is displeased with your answer.
say:18:1520909009:0.source_cn: 狩猎神大人对你的回答不满意。
say:18:1520909009:0.male: The Hunting God is displeased with your answer.
say:18:1520909009:0.female: The Hunting Goddess is displeased with your answer.

say:19:1520909010:0.text: This... this is the tradition of Wildborn. Without the Herdmaster's command, I can only follow...
say:19:1520909010:0.source_cn: 这……这是雅库伯尔的传统。没有兽群之主发话，我只能遵循……
say:19:1520909010:0.male: This... this is the tradition of Wildborn. Without the Herdmaster's command, I can only follow...
say:19:1520909010:0.female: This... this is the tradition of Wildborn. Without the Herdmaster's command, I can only follow...

say:22:1520909011:0.text: Great Hunting God... please don't punish the witch doctors... our injuries are due to our weakness.
say:22:1520909011:0.source_cn: 伟大的狩猎神……求你不要责罚巫医……我们受的伤，都是因...
say:22:1520909011:0.male: Great Hunting God... please don't punish the witch doctors... our injuries are due to our weakness.
say:22:1520909011:0.female: Great Hunting Goddess... please don't punish the witch doctors... our injuries are due to our weakness.

say:23:1520909012:0.text: To see you before we die, we have no regrets!
say:23:1520909012:0.source_cn: 能在死前见到你，我们已经死而无憾了……！
say:23:1520909012:0.male: To see you before we die, we have no regrets!
say:23:1520909012:0.female: To see you before we die, we have no regrets!

say:26:1520909013:0.text: Yes... a wretch like me never dreamed of gazing upon a god...
say:26:1520909013:0.source_cn: 是……是啊……我从没想过……像我这么没用的战士，还能…...
say:26:1520909013:0.male: Yes... a wretch like me never dreamed of gazing upon a god...
say:26:1520909013:0.female: Yes... a wretch like me never dreamed of gazing upon a goddess...

say:31:1520909015:0.text: Lei! No... you can't die! I will find a way to save you...
say:31:1520909015:0.source_cn: 蕾！不……不行！你不可以死！我一定有办法救你的……

choice_prompt:32:1520909015.text: Lei! No... you can't die! I will find a way to save you...
choice_prompt:32:1520909015.source_cn: 蕾！不……不行！你不可以死！我一定有办法救你的……

say:37:1520909017:0.text: The Hunting God does not judge. Speak freely.
say:37:1520909017:0.source_cn: 狩猎神大人不会责怪你。你可以说实话。
say:37:1520909017:0.male: The Hunting God does not judge. Speak freely.
say:37:1520909017:0.female: The Hunting Goddess does not judge. Speak freely.

say:38:1520909018:0.text: I... I want to live! I want us all to live!
say:38:1520909018:0.source_cn: 我……我不想死……我想活下去，我想让大家都活下去！

say:41:1520909019:0.source_cn: 绒耳？！你、你怎么能有这种想法……！

say:42:1520909020:0.text: We've been so badly injured... we'll never be able to fight or hunt again. What use are we to the Herdmaster or the Wildborn except as sacrifices?
say:42:1520909020:0.source_cn: 我们受了这么重的伤，以后都没办法再战斗和捕猎……除了去...
say:42:1520909020:0.male: We've been so badly injured... we'll never be able to fight or hunt again. What use are we to the Herdmaster or the Wildborn except as sacrifices?
say:42:1520909020:0.female: We've been so badly injured... we'll never be able to fight or hunt again. What use are we to the Herdmaster or the Wildborn except as sacrifices?

say:43:1520909021:0.text: Even if I'm useless... I still want to live.
say:43:1520909021:0.source_cn: 就算没用……我也想活下去。

say:44:1520909022:0.text: Otherwise... why have I been helping you clean wounds all this time?!
say:44:1520909022:0.source_cn: 要不然……我为什么一直在帮你们清理伤口？！

say:49:1520909025:0.text: Only the Wild Moon's will. His is absolute.
say:49:1520909025:0.source_cn: 当然是雅库伯尔之月！<male>他</male><fe...
say:49:1520909025:0.male: Only the Wild Moon's will. His is absolute.
say:49:1520909025:0.female: Only the Wild Moon's will. Hers is absolute.

say:51:1520909026:0.text: Yes. The Hunting God has come to heal your wounds.
say:51:1520909026:0.source_cn: 是的。狩猎神大人来到这里，就是为了治愈你们的伤。
say:51:1520909026:0.male: Yes. The Hunting God has come to heal your wounds.
say:51:1520909026:0.female: Yes. The Hunting Goddess has come to heal your wounds.

say:54:1520909028:0.text: It's true, my wounds were healed by the Herdmaster!
say:54:1520909028:0.source_cn: 没错，俺的伤就是狩猎神治好的！
say:54:1520909028:0.male: It's true, my wounds were healed by the Herdmaster!
say:54:1520909028:0.female: It's true, my wounds were healed by the Herdmaster!

choice:32:0:1.text: It seems your thoughts differ from theirs.
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 看来你的想法和他们不太一样
choice:32:0:1.male: It seems your thoughts differ from theirs.
choice:32:0:1.female: It seems your thoughts differ from theirs.

choice:13:0:1.text: But some of them are about to die!
choice:13:0:1.male: But some of them are about to die!
choice:13:0:1.female: But some of them are about to die!

choice:13:1:2.text: They look worse than Hoof did...

choice:13:1:2.female: They look worse than Hoof did...

cinematic_dialogue:2:1520910001:.text: Huh? How did I get here?

cinematic_dialogue:2:1520910004:.text: It feels like I had a dream...

say:5:1520911001:0.text: Oh, indeed... your wounds are gone!
say:5:1520911001:0.source_cn: 噢，果然……你们身上的伤果然都好了！

say:6:1520911002:0.text: Don't just stand there! Quickly, thank the great Wild Moon!
say:6:1520911002:0.source_cn: 别愣着，快感谢伟大的雅库伯尔之月！
say:6:1520911002:0.male: Don't just stand there! Quickly, thank the great Wild Moon!
say:6:1520911002:0.female: Don't just stand there! Quickly, thank the great Wild Moon!

say:9:1520911004:0.source_cn: 这是神迹！真正的神迹啊！

say:11:1520911005:0.text: The blessing ceremony hasn't even begun, yet I've witnessed divinity! I can die content!
say:11:1520911005:0.source_cn: 赐福仪式还没有正式举办，我居然就亲眼见证了神迹！简直死...

choice_prompt:12:1520911005.text: The blessing ceremony hasn't even begun, yet I've witnessed divinity! I can die content!

say:13:1520911006:0.female: Ah, forgive me... I'll speak no more of it.

say:15:1520911007:0.source_cn: 那个战士……你是叫绒耳，对吧？

say:16:1520911008:0.text: You just said you've been helping others clean wounds. When did you learn that?
say:16:1520911008:0.source_cn: 你刚才说你一直在帮其他人清理伤口，你是什么时候学会的？

say:17:1520911009:0.text: I often get injured while hunting. I learned by watching you treat my wounds a few times.
say:17:1520911009:0.source_cn: ……我经常在捕猎时受伤。看你们为我治疗过几次，就学会了。

say:18:1520911010:0.text: Hmm... good. That makes you valuable.
say:18:1520911010:0.source_cn: 嗯……很好。这能让你变得更有用一点。

choice_prompt:19:1520911010.text: Hmm... good. That makes you valuable.
choice_prompt:19:1520911010.source_cn: 嗯……很好。这能让你变得更有用一点。

say:20:1520911011:0.source_cn: 是，我绝对不会辜负狩猎神大人的嘱托。

say:21:1520911012:0.text: You all, come with me. I'll find more suitable tasks for you.
say:21:1520911012:0.source_cn: 你们几个都跟我来。我会给你们找到更合适的差事。

say:27:1520911015:0.text: When their wounds are too severe, they may not heal, and it wastes medicine.
say:27:1520911015:0.source_cn: 受的伤太重，不一定能治好，还会浪费药草。

say:29:1520911017:0.female: Better to return their souls to the Wild Moon, to bless the Wildborn.
